module: Career money milestones. Each milestone accumulates, for a mode (gains or losses) and tags, the amounts tracked by career_modules_playerAttributes.getAttribute("money")[mode][tag] (absolute value). Seven milestones: gains (tag reward), spending (buying), parts bought (partsBought), vehicles bought (vehicleBought), sales (selling), deliveries (delivery), fines (fine). Two Steam achievements are tied to gains: FIRST_PAYCHECK (10,000) and SIX_FIGURES (100,000).
notes: Generic tiers (gains/spending): 1000, 2000, 5000, 10000, 20000, 50000, 100000, 200000, 500000, 1000000. Other milestones: their own short values (e.g. fine {500,1500,5000}).
Only the "reward" gains and "buying" spending milestones have the general filter; all have money.
Achievements are unlocked via gameplay_achievement.unlockAchievement as soon as the total exceeds the amount, on each tier notification.

onGeneralMilestonesCollect.desc: Hook: creates one milestone per mode configuration and adds it to milestonesList (save data created if absent).

onGeneralMilestonesSetupCallbacks.desc: Hook: sets the notification target of each money milestone.

setNotificationTarget.desc: Stores in milestoneConfig._target the target of the next tier to notify (nothing if all are notified).

onPlayerAttributesChanged.desc: Hook: if the money attribute changed, checks each milestone, unlocks any achievements, notifies the reached tier and advances notificationStep.
